name: Eagles Wings
overview: The imagery of eagles' wings in Scripture vividly illustrates God's protective care and sustaining power for His people. Passages such as Exodus 19:4 and Deuteronomy 32:11 depict God bearing and nurturing His people as an eagle carries and shelters its young. Psalm 91:4 emphasizes trusting under God's wings as a refuge, while Isaiah 40:31 promises renewed strength and endurance to those who wait on the Lord, enabling them to soar like eagles. Together, these verses reveal a profound picture of divine provision, renewal, and faithful protection grounded in the character of God.
